rationale: The range adds vendor-namespaced capability-control operations: four fixed dev.pulp.vendor tier capabilities, a build-time vendor operation declaration carried in the control manifest, broker resolution and exact-operation grant scoping, a pulp-mcp call tool, and a CLI path. It touches the control capability inventory and Standalone control host only. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves, and no visual-proof harness behavior changes.
